name.meaning: She that is to be examined

summary_for_children: Al-Mumtahanah means She Who Is Examined. It points to Ibrahim as an example and teaches being just and kind to people who are not hostile.
environment_concept: A border land where bridges stand between communities, teaching justice and kindness to those who do not fight us.
architecture_and_scenery: Two villages separated by a river, bridges rebuilt for fair dealing.

areas.name: Hope of Affection
areas.description: A garden where enemies may become friends.
